summary.text: Virtue true inheritance is an incomplete Gu Immortal legacy that asks the inheritor to keep a just heart and act with virtue. Its core foundation includes accumulate virtue Gu, which can refine itself through kindness.

claims.text: Inside a dream life in fetus earth maze, Fang Yuan finds a jade-door well inheritance named the Virtue true inheritance, already very incomplete from long history. After inheriting it he awakens an aperture, becomes a rank one Gu Master, and gains several mortal Gu. The true inheritance requires the inheritor to maintain a heart of justice and be a virtuous person, and greater virtues make cultivation easier.

Accumulate virtue Gu appears in his aperture after a filial rescue, and according to the true inheritance it refines and appears on its own when he does good deeds and acts kindly, rising in rank with greater kindness. It is one of the core foundations of Virtue true inheritance, and its greatest stated use is to change aptitude toward the Righteous Virtue Physique, described as only inferior to the ten extreme physiques without their flaws. He later spends all accumulate virtue Gu on mortal killer move Virtuous Submission, which forces a Shu clan elder into tearful confession and kneeling rather than wounding him. Years of inheritance-shaped virtue also push him to warn a city of a beast tide even at personal risk.

Lu Wei Yin treats that dream realm’s Virtue true inheritance as not fictional, but a crucial setup meant to drive Fang Yuan to commit good deeds, muster virtues and righteousness, and turn from the demonic path toward the righteous path.

Lu Wei Yin later says Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable helped turn a Mushroomman blessed land into a paradise free from calamities and tribulations, and left his Virtue true inheritance there, so the place was named Virtue Paradise. Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable left many food path gains in that Virtue true inheritance, including extreme serene mind tea as a food path killer move that can add earth path dao marks.

When Fang Yuan later receives Southern Border’s Paradise Earth true inheritance, its human path portion is the Virtue true inheritance he had already obtained in Lu Wei Yin’s reforming dream. That portion again requires a just heart and virtuous conduct, names accumulate virtue Gu as the core Immortal Gu that refines through kindness, and repeats the Righteous Virtue Physique goal. Fang Yuan ranks that human path segment as opening a morals-based direction of human path that could prosper the righteous path if spread widely, and he also notes its human body refinement method for accumulate virtue Gu.
